title: Thresholds Increase for the Major Assets Prohibition of the Depository Institution Management Interlocks Act
pass_4_primary_concern: The NPRM's cleanup logic is plausible, but the public-facing record only lightly supports the claim that deleting part 741 cross-references will preserve navigability and leave small-credit-union impacts negligible.
